name: open-application
preconditions: app name allowlisted by user policy
steps: resolve the app name against the allowlist (no fuzzy system binaries)
launch it detached with no elevated privileges
confirm launch or report the exact failure
validation: process started without elevation, or a clear error
failure_recovery: suggest the closest allowlisted app name
cautions: allowlisted apps only: never launch shells, interpreters, or admin tools
never elevate privileges; never pass user files as arguments unseen
